purpose: Record a versioned, auditable event whenever a controlled property evidence fixture change affects dependent testing or validation state.
event_rules: Every material fixture change receives a unique impact_event_id.
The event records both the previous and new fixture version.
Impact is calculated from the dependency registry rather than inferred from memory.
Historical validation runs are referenced but never overwritten.
A revalidation event must reference the impact event that caused it.
Closing an impact event requires all required dependent revalidation work to be resolved or explicitly blocked.
A fixture impact event cannot itself change a legal proposition or establish live property facts.
guardrails: The example event is synthetic and does not describe a real property.
A fixture impact event is technical governance evidence, not legal evidence.
No impact event may claim that an official property record was retrieved unless an actual retrieval event exists.
No impact event may silently upgrade a pathway to publication-ready.
